problems.what: the instruction to let attention stay with one detail long enough to become curious; examples lost
problems.replace: perhaps there was something of interest to you in all of this
problems.with: you may find one detail that holds your interest, something about the sound, or the contact, or that particular way of listening, and let attention stay with it long enough to become curious

problems.what: the person who has begun to speak and hasn't found the words; remaining nearby without finishing their sentence
problems.replace: someone dear to you
problems.with: someone dear to you who has begun to speak and hasn’t yet found the words. You can remain nearby, listening, without finishing their sentence for them

problems.what: 'say it as an invitation' lost; 'how it is received' became 'how it is for you'
problems.replace: Try a phrase that you choose for yourself to see how it is for you
problems.with: Let the phrase you chose come to mind, say it as an invitation, and notice how it is received

problems.what: 'let that be a choice you make' and the background room sound staying available while listening deepens
problems.replace: as you proceed
problems.with: as you proceed. Let that be a choice you make. Listening may deepen while a sound from the room remains available in the background

problems.what: 'slowly' and 'each number its own moment' lost; instruction softened to 'if you like'
problems.replace: If you like, count to yourself, from 5 to 1
problems.with: Count slowly from 5 to 1, giving each number its own moment

problems.what: 'let attention gather around what you find' became 'notice what you notice'
problems.replace: and notice what you notice
problems.with: let attention gather around what you find

problems.what: 'after the words' (where the space is left)
problems.replace: leave some space
problems.with: leave a little space after the words

problems.what: 'without preparing an answer' and the final 'Stay here for a moment'
problems.replace: and listen, even to the silence, 1
problems.with: listen into that space, without preparing an answer, 1, stay here for a moment

problems.what: 'your chosen concern' became 'what you want to contact'
problems.replace: what it is that you want to contact
problems.with: your chosen concern

problems.what: 'let it be present without rehearsing its whole story'
problems.replace: stay with the wish to contact.
problems.with: stay with the wish to contact. Let it be present without rehearsing its whole story.

problems.what: 'nothing clear yet' became the stronger 'nothing at all'
problems.replace: or nothing at all
problems.with: or nothing clear yet

problems.what: 'stabilize before making it stronger' became 'not to make it stronger'
problems.replace: This is to stabilize your state, not to make it stronger.
problems.with: This is to stabilize your state before making it stronger.

problems.what: 'do not need to intensify' turned into 'make it stronger'; 'stabilize it, keep it kind' lost
problems.replace: I already have an open state, now I want to aim that open state and make it stronger.
problems.with: “The state is already open. I do not need to intensify it. I need to aim it, stabilize it, and keep it kind.”

problems.what: naming where you are and the date (or day), and feeling feet, hands and spine
problems.replace: Look around you, orient yourself to where you are, what date it is.
problems.with: Look around the room. Name where you are. Name the date, or at least the day. Feel your feet, hands, and spine.

problems.what: 'gently but firmly' pressing became 'squeezing'
problems.replace: squeezing your thumbs against your index fingers
problems.with: pressing your thumbs gently but firmly against your index fingers

problems.what: script lost its opening quotation mark, so it reads as narration
problems.replace: Now, I will only allow
problems.with: “I will only allow

problems.what: 'Anything too much can wait'
problems.replace: go as far as I can integrate.
problems.with: go as far as I can integrate. Anything too much can wait.

problems.what: 'The body may stay safe' became the firmer 'My body will be safe'
problems.replace: My body will be safe
problems.with: My body may stay safe

problems.what: script lost its closing quotation mark, so it reads as narration
problems.replace: doesn't have to do this alone.
problems.with: doesn't have to do this alone.”

problems.what: 'Once you're oriented, choose one intention'; 'Please show me the next useful truth... amount I can live well with'
problems.replace: Now, tell me the next thing I need to know, in symbols, feelings, questions, actions, in doses that I can integrate.
problems.with: Once you’re oriented, choose one intention: “Please show me the next useful truth, symbol, feeling, question, or action — only in the amount I can live well with.”

problems.what: script line turned into narration; 'I am coming more fully here' became 'you are coming more'
problems.replace: Begin by saying to yourself that you are not going to go away in this practice, you are coming more.
problems.with: Begin by saying: “I am not going away. I am coming more fully here.”
